purpose: Finite-input parity of append-only versus invalid-row canonicalizing _with_validity

protocol.data_source: evaluate_gnn_baselines.build_snapshots on checked network train/test JSON and checked local scorer artifacts
protocol.old_representation: concatenate raw X and validity channel
protocol.new_representation: zero invalid X rows, then concatenate validity channel
protocol.comparison: separate same-seed refits; maximum absolute state_dict and valid-output differences

boundedness: One of four real benchmark scenarios and three rather than 300 epochs; this verifies arithmetic parity, not final metric reproducibility.
